disclaimer: Illustrative, requires clinician approval. Prototype only — never gives medical diagnosis or prescribing advice.

rules.description: Visit due soon (within reminder lead time)
rules.explanationTemplate: Visit due soon in {daysUntilDue} day(s) on {dueDate}. Scheduled for routine follow-up.
Check-in overdue by {daysOverdue} day(s) (exceeded grace period of {gracePeriod} days). Contact patient for follow-up.
Repeated missed follow-up: {missedReason}. Flagged for supervisor review and outreach coordination.

rules.description: Blood pressure elevated above cohort threshold
rules.explanationTemplate: BP {systolic}/{diastolic} mmHg is at or above configured threshold of {thresholdSystolic}/{thresholdDiastolic} mmHg. Flagged for clinician review.

rules.description: Rising blood pressure trend across consecutive readings
rules.explanationTemplate: Systolic blood pressure rose consistently across the last 3 check-ins ({readings}). Flagged for clinician review.
Danger-sign symptom reported: '{symptomName}'. Flagged for clinician review.

rules.description: Physiological value outside plausible range (data quality check)
rules.explanationTemplate: Recorded value '{metric}' of {value} is outside physiologically plausible range ({min} - {max}). Possible data-entry error; flagged for review and re-check.

rules.description: Blood glucose out of target bounds for diabetes cohort
rules.explanationTemplate: Blood glucose {metric} of {value} mg/dL is outside target limit ({min} - {max} mg/dL). Flagged for clinician review.
